$comment: GENUINE live behavioral attestations ONLY — never fabricated. Each record is the recorded provenance of a real `npm run test:case` run (see tools/test-runner.mjs / tools/runs/<runId>/<harness>/run.json). A `pass` behavioral attestation proves the pack, placed at a harness's canonical discovery path and driven headless, is discovered and produces the semantic outcome — the behavioral half every supported (channel × harness) cell for that harness needs; the deterministic half (packaging/paths/provenance) is proven by the tests named in tools/acceptance/matrix.mjs. A harness WITHOUT a passing attestation has its supported cells recorded as pending and WITHHELD from advertised support (registry + generated README), enforced by tools/acceptance/matrix.test.mjs. Add attestations only from a genuine recorded run; do not hand-edit verdicts.
